title: A policy variable with no value
question: What happens to a statement whose policy variable has no value? AWS's docs disagree: a note says it "might cause the entire statement to be invalid", and the section on variables with no value says the resource "will not match any resource". The analyzer refuses.

cases.name: allow_control
cases.description: An Allow on the team's bucket, for a caller with no team tag.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: either reading: the resource matches nothing, or the statement is dropped

cases.name: deny_not_resource
cases.description: A Deny on every bucket but the team's, under an Allow for all of S3, for a caller with no team tag.

readings.EXPLICIT_DENY: the variable's resource matches nothing, so NotResource covers every resource and the Deny applies
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: neither: the simulator's handling of a key left out of the call (see calibration)
